The '''''Padawan's Resource Guide''''' was a document that was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It included a section on the subject of the [[Almas Academy]] and the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] that students of the [[Jedi academy|academy]] had to pass in order to become [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].
